title: Anthropomorphization of AI: Opportunities and Risks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith/religion. It mentions 'religion' as a protected demographic category from the 'Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights' in the context of algorithmic discrimination, but the analysis presented focuses on other demographics like race and gender.
findings: The paper's main finding related to religion is that it is listed as a protected category in the 'Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights,' which prohibits algorithmic discrimination. However, the paper presents no specific experimental findings or analysis concerning religion, focusing instead on other demographics.
